title: Call Service
text: Call service in ROS network, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Source} sets Source for specifying service name Select from ROS network; {Name} sets the service name character vector, {Type} sets the service type character vector, {Connection timeout} sets the timeout for service server connection, {Keep persistent connection} sets the keep connection to service server and {Show ErrorCode output port} enables error code output port. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: ErrorCode
ports.summary: Error conditions for service call integer

params.name: Source
params.values: Source for specifying service name Select from ROS network | Specify your own

params.name: Connection timeout
params.values: Timeout for service server connection 5 (default) | positive numeric scalar

params.name: Keep persistent connection
params.values: Keep connection to service server off (default) | on

params.name: Show ErrorCode output port
params.values: Enable error code output port on (default) | off
